params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $head=(git rev-parse HEAD).Trim(); Write-Output ('HEAD=' + $head); if($head -ne 'b9685d2f2e32af99596dc90d46278a129106d8e2'){ throw ('Unexpected reconciliation HEAD: '+$head) }; $dirty=(git status --porcelain); if($dirty){ Write-Output $dirty; throw 'Reconciled worktree is dirty before verification' }; Set-Location 'tools\agent-control'; node --version; npm --version; npm run check; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}; npm test; exit $LASTEXITCODE
